comparison.objective: Fill three drywall nail holes with spackle and strike the patches flush.
comparison.physical_skill: Load and angle a putty knife, pack material, and skim a controlled surface finish.
comparison.success_condition: Holes filled within depth tolerance, minimal proud material, no torn paper, and knife set down.
comparison.reason: Tests material deposition and surface finishing; it has no loose-body sorting, bimanual screen handling, or aperture passage.
